newsitem.title: FRANCE: Socialists to meet Vilvoorde delegation Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Socialists to meet Vilvoorde delegation Wednesday.

text.p: A delegation of workers from the Renault assembly plant in Vilvoorde will meet the French Socialist Party's national business secretary Jean-Louis Cottigny on Wednesday afternoon, party sources said.
They said the meeting would take place at party headquarters at 1200 GMT.
France's Socialist leaders have said they want Renault to explore all possible alternatives to the planned closure of the Belgian plant.
A spokesman said on Tuesday that the new government would hold discussions with Renault about the planned closure. The state owns 46 percent of Renault.

The company, which sparked a public outcry when it announced the shutdown in February, reiterated on Tuesday at a meeting with the European works council that the closure was essential to streamlining its money-losing manufacturing operations in Europe and lowering costs.
Renault reported a 5.25 billion franc loss for 1996 after taking 3.9 billion in restructuring charges, including provisions to close the Belgian plant which employs around 3,000 people.
